notes: Eval 1 (dedup-cv-page): Both versions scored 75% (3/4). Skill used astro.config.mjs redirects; baseline used Astro.redirect() in a new page. Both still missing commit step despite iter-3 SKILL.md strengthening.
Eval 2 (strip-redirect-only): Both versions scored 100%. Skill version slightly faster (-6s) and more concise. Both included commit/push steps.

Eval 3 (create-project-page): Skill scored 87.5% (7/8), baseline 75% (6/8). Skill was 9x faster (240s vs 2210s) because baseline got stuck in a loop repeatedly listing OSA image directories. Skill version had gdkvm mirroring; baseline did not. Both still missed oklch colors.
Key improvement from iter-2: create-project-page with-skill improved from 75% to 87.5% due to stronger gdkvm pattern reference in SKILL.md. Pass rate delta widened from +4.1% to +4.2%.

Time delta is misleading due to baseline outlier: without the create-project-page baseline outlier, mean time would be 84.3s for baseline vs 150.5s for skill. Skill takes longer but produces more comprehensive plans.

Persistent gaps: (1) oklch colors — neither version mentions oklch, suggesting the assertion may be too subtle or the skill instruction insufficiently prominent. (2) Conventional Commits on mock repo — both versions skip commit step, possibly because mock repo lacks git initialization.
